heard: lookouts on the Titanic had no binoculars. Many believe the ship sailed without them by mistake. But on the delivery trip, David Blair lent them his own pair. A sudden officer reshuffle then forced Blair off the ship. Disappointed, he packed his bags and walked down the game plank. Lookout Frederick Fleet testified they would have spotted the iceberg sooner. With Blair reassigned, he inadvertently carried off the key.
